svg.aria-label: Electric air turbo-rocket: motors drive a CNT fan and compressor; a separate turbopump running in 5,000 K reverter gas makes the power, and its exhaust burns in the main combustor. Ammonia cools the hot section and then feeds the reverter. Doors switch the engine between turbine, ramjet and rocket modes.
svg.text: Electric air turbo-rocket: the fighter's engine
Motors drive the fan and compressor. A turbopump running in reverter gas, never in air, makes the power. Schematic, not to scale.

g.text: CNT compressor · a motor per rotor
